purpose: Define each P2P message as an explicit identity with sender/recipient/conversation refs, content envelope and delivery state separate from transport packet identity.

topics.name: P2P Message Identity
topics.purpose: Define each P2P message as an explicit identity with sender/recipient/conversation refs, content envelope and delivery state separate from transport packet identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each application message has an explicit message identity.
semantics.transport_rule: WebRTC/WebSocket packet/frame identity does not replace message identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Receiving a message never grants operation authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: packet id used as message identity
